findings.reason: one clause fixing which reading both clauses use (ceiling and reserve computed from the same backlog, or §5 capped at the amount §4 reserved) closes a real-money gap in the cost guard, and without it the coordinator's §4 limit and §5 cap disagree by whatever §4 adds to the backlog.
findings.text: §5's ceiling is "the measured documentation rate times the backlog, plus a quarter", where "the backlog" is what §5 reads at its own start (after §4 has run), while §4's limit reserves "the unspent part of §5's documentation ceiling … computed at dispatch" from the pre-§4 backlog; §4's done-when requires +300 accepted sources, which adds accepted names whose documentation is pending, so the post-§4 backlog is larger than the reserved one. Read the other way — the ceiling fixed at §4's dispatch — §5 is instead sized on a backlog §4 is about to grow and may be under-funded by the same difference. Either reading leaves one of the two clauses wrong, and in the first the growth is drawn from the USD 60 tranche reserved for `sn-catalog-consistency` §2.

findings.reason: adding the reported stage to the control makes it able to fail on the classification the measure depends on; without it the control passes on a read-back that cannot detect the backlog at all.
findings.text: §5's negative control reads "the read-back counts a name planted with pending documentation in a disposable graph"; it constrains only that the planted name is counted somewhere, not that it is reported as pending rather than as accepted, so a read-back that classifies every name as accepted-documented still satisfies the control while the section's measure ("every accepted name whose documentation is not accepted") is wrong. §2's analogous control states the required classification explicitly ("as not produced"), and §5 does not.

findings.reason: a worker dispatched to §5 cannot check the premise (the fall from 2,368 to 2,028) from anything the plan points at, so the plan should cite a landed record path and that record must be merged.
findings.text: §5 states the drain's before/after counts and its USD 11.14 spend as fact, but its only citation is `sn-integrity-backlog` §52, whose content records none of those figures; the record that does (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-docs-drain-after-admission.html`, commit `7aef43b21`) is not present in the tree at `origin/main` (`c7afaf13f`), so a later reader opening the plan's citation cannot verify the premise the section is built on.
